video_caption: The video features Kellyanne Conway, a fair-skinned woman with blonde hair, wearing a colorful floral-patterned dress, speaking directly to the camera with varying earnest and animated expressions, often gesturing with her hands. An American flag stands in the blurry background to her left, with a glimpse of what appears to be a fireplace or dark wooden furniture. A text overlay initially identifies her as "Kellyanne Conway, Senior Counselor to the President," accompanied by a "SHOWTIME" logo in the bottom right corner of the screen. Interspersed with Conway's speech are shots of a second fair-skinned woman with blonde hair, wearing a dark blue top, listening intently with a neutral, slightly smiling expression. The video transitions between close-ups of Conway's face and wider shots showing her seated in a dark leather armchair, maintaining her expressive delivery and hand movements.

The video features two women in a dimly lit, ornate room, likely for an interview. The first woman, with blonde hair and wearing a dark blue top, is seated on the left and actively speaking, gesturing with her right hand. She is addressing the second woman, who has long blonde hair and is wearing a colorful floral dress, sitting in a dark leather armchair on the right. An American flag is prominently displayed in the background behind the second woman, along with a grand fireplace and framed artwork. The scene alternates between close-ups of each woman speaking and a wider shot showing both, confirming their interaction. During the second woman's turn to speak, a black and white close-up of a man, possibly Joe Biden, is briefly intercut, showing him smiling and later with a more serious expression. Towards the end, the second woman, while speaking, appears to gag or choke, showing a look of distress on her face. A "SHOWTIME" logo is consistently present in the bottom right corner of the screen.

The video features two blonde-haired women engaged in conversation, with cuts between their individual shots. The first woman, wearing a dark top, is shown in profile, looking up and to the right as she speaks animatedly, often gesturing with her hands. She is in a dimly lit room with a bright window and patterned curtains in the background. The second woman, wearing a colorful floral top, is seen more frontally, looking towards the camera as she speaks, occasionally gesturing with her right hand and maintaining a composed expression. Her background is darker, with a blurred American flag visible to her left. Both shots feature the "SHOWTIME" logo in the bottom right corner. The conversation touches on political topics, including re-election, "the incumbent outsider," Joe Biden, "radical left," "Bernie Manifesto," and "AOC on Green New Deal," as well as past election years "16" and "18."

Two women are seated in a grand, ornately decorated room, engaged in an interview or discussion. The woman on the left, with blonde hair and wearing a black short-sleeved top, sits on a dark leather couch, actively speaking and gesturing with her hands. Opposite her, the woman on the right, also with blonde hair and wearing a colorful floral/abstract patterned dress, sits in a dark leather armchair, listening intently with a slight, calm smile, her legs crossed. Between them, a small table holds a dark object. In the background, a large grey ornate fireplace with a mantelpiece features a framed portrait of a historical figure and two lamps. A long black microphone hangs down from above the frame, positioned between the two women. To the right, an American flag stands upright. The camera then zooms in on the first woman as she speaks, clapping her hands together, then making open-palmed gestures to emphasize her words. The scene cuts to a closer shot of the second woman, who maintains her composed expression while listening. Finally, the camera returns to the first woman, who dramatically spreads her hands apart with an intense, emphatic expression. The "SHOWTIME" logo is visible in the bottom right corner throughout the segment.

The video segment features two blonde women in separate interview settings. The first woman, with shoulder-length blonde hair and wearing a dark blue top, is initially seen smiling and looking off-screen in a dimly lit room with ornate wooden furniture. She later appears twice more, once looking upwards and touching her collar, then gesturing with her hands, both times with bright, curtained windows in the background, making her partially silhouetted. The second woman, with longer blonde hair and wearing a vibrant floral V-neck top, sits in a dark leather chair, speaking and gesturing. An American flag is prominently displayed in the background to her left. She maintains a serious expression throughout her appearances. A white "SHOWTIME" logo is consistently present in the bottom right corner of the screen.

The video segment opens with a close-up shot of a woman's hand, displaying long, light-colored nails, making a slight downward gesture against a dark, out-of-focus background. The Showtime logo is visible in the bottom right corner. The camera then quickly pans up to reveal a blonde woman, identified as Kellyanne Conway, wearing a vibrant, multi-colored floral dress. She is sitting in a dark leather chair, speaking and looking slightly to her right, with an American flag partially visible in the background to her left. Her expression is serious as she talks. The scene then cuts to a different blonde woman, seen in profile, wearing a dark top, looking intently to her left. She is in a brighter room with a window and ornate architectural details in the background. The video then returns to Kellyanne Conway, who continues to speak directly to someone off-camera, occasionally gesturing with her hands, and briefly showing a faint smile. The Showtime logo remains present throughout the segment.

The video segment features two women engaged in a conversation within a formal room setting, indicated by ornate curtains, a fireplace, and an American flag. One woman, with shorter blonde hair and a dark top, is actively speaking and gesturing emphatically with her hands, sometimes pointing a finger, conveying a serious and engaged demeanor. The second woman, identifiable as Kellyanne Conway with longer blonde hair and a colorful floral top, is also speaking, maintaining a calmer yet equally serious expression, occasionally touching her chin thoughtfully. The lighting varies, at times casting the first woman in silhouette against a bright window, and at other times illuminating both speakers clearly. Throughout the video, the "SHOWTIME" logo is displayed in the bottom right corner.

The video segment features a woman with blonde hair, wearing a colorful, V-neck top, speaking directly to the camera, interspersed with shots of another woman with blonde hair, wearing a black top, listening intently to the speaker. The speaking woman often gestures with her hands, displaying engaged and animated expressions, particularly a smile around 0:08 and 0:27, and emphasizing points with her fingers at 0:20 and 0:30. In the background of the speaking woman's shots, an American flag is partially visible on the left, and a dark wooden interior suggests a formal setting. The listening woman is mostly shown in silhouette or from the side, seated on a dark leather armchair, looking towards the speaker. Her backdrop includes large windows with patterned curtains, ornate wall decor, and a fireplace in the distance in some wider shots. At 0:38, a wider shot reveals both women in the same room, with the woman in the black top holding a mug and gesturing while the woman in the colorful top listens, indicating an interview or conversation. The "SHOWTIME" logo is consistently present in the bottom right corner of the screen.

The video opens with a blonde woman, likely an interviewer, in a dark top, speaking and gesturing in a dimly lit, ornate room with windows and gold architectural details. This cuts to a close-up of a second blonde woman, the interviewee, wearing a colorful floral dress, looking forward with a serious expression, with a blurred American flag in the background. The video then alternates between these two women speaking, with the interviewee's expressions ranging from intent listening to active speaking and conveying emphasis. At 00:16, the footage transitions to black and white scenes depicting civil unrest: a crowd of people facing bright lights, police officers in riot gear with shields, individuals running through smoke-filled streets, people breaking into a storefront, and burning cars in a street, with a lone figure walking past. The scene then returns to the interviewee speaking, followed by more black and white footage: a group of men, some armed with rifles, standing under a gas station canopy; two men, one in a robe and the other holding a rifle, conversing outdoors; and another group of men near an SUV at night, some possibly armed. The video then switches back to the interviewer speaking in the ornate room, and finally concludes with the interviewee, again with the American flag behind her, speaking with a more stern and perhaps frustrated expression. A "SHOWTIME" logo is consistently displayed in the bottom right corner throughout the video.

The video segment features a blonde woman in a colorful, patterned top, identified as Kellyanne Conway, speaking directly to someone off-camera. She gestures with her hands as she discusses cities and suburbs being destroyed by non-peaceful protestors, questioning if those who killed two people in Kenosha with firearms were peaceful or committing murder. The scene frequently cuts to another blonde woman, identified as Jennifer Palmieri, wearing a dark top, who is listening and occasionally reacting, at one point clapping her hands together, and at other times appearing thoughtful or pained. An American flag is visible in the background behind Conway. The overall setting appears to be an indoor interview or discussion, with dim lighting and some natural light coming from a window in the background when Palmieri is shown. A "SHOWTIME" logo is consistently present in the bottom right corner. Towards the end, a high-pitched ringing sound is heard as Conway maintains a serious, almost contemplative expression, before the sound abruptly cuts off.

The video features an alternating shot between two blonde women engaged in what appears to be an interview or discussion. The first woman, with medium-length blonde hair and a dark top, is seen in a dimly lit room with bright windows in the background, creating a silhouette effect. She actively gestures with her hands as she speaks, sometimes looking slightly away from the camera. The second woman, with long blonde hair and a vibrant floral print V-neck top, is shown in a slightly brighter setting, with a blurred American flag visible in the background to her left. She also gestures with her hands, occasionally touching her neck or bringing her fingers to her mouth while speaking. Both women exhibit serious and engaged expressions throughout the segment, conveying a deep involvement in the conversation. The "SHOWTIME" logo is displayed in the bottom right corner of the screen for the entire duration of the clip.

The video segment features two blonde women in an indoor setting, possibly an interview or documentary. The first woman, with a serious expression and wearing a dark top, is initially seen sitting on a dark leather sofa against a dimly lit background with ornate furniture and a framed picture. She then reappears with a more reflective look, sitting in front of a brighter window with curtains. Interspersed with these shots is a close-up of a different blonde woman, Kellyanne Conway, wearing a colorful floral print top, speaking directly to the camera with a blurred American flag and dark wooden furniture behind her. The "SHOWTIME" logo is consistently displayed in the bottom right corner.

The video opens with a woman with shoulder-length blonde hair and a black top, looking thoughtful and slightly concerned in a dimly lit room with ornate dark furniture, while the "SHOWTIME" logo appears in the bottom right corner. This transitions to a different woman with long blonde hair and a colorful floral dress, speaking animatedly and gesturing with her hands, appearing confident. The camera then cuts back to the first woman, now in a brighter setting with windows in the background, looking pensive with her hand to her chin. The second woman is shown again, with a US flag in the background, looking towards someone off-screen with a slight, knowing smile. The first woman briefly reappears, looking intently at the second, before the second woman smiles broadly. The scene then transitions to a red, white, and blue graphic featuring stars and stripes, with the text "THE CIRCUS INSIDE THE CRAZIEST POLITICAL CAMPAIGN ON EARTH" at the top, and "NEW EPISODES #SHOCircus SHO" (Showtime) below. This briefly flashes to a white screen with diagonal black lines, then to a solid red screen with "ONLY ON SHOWTIME" in white, framed by the patriotic patterns. The video concludes with the "THE CIRCUS INSIDE THE CRAZIEST POLITICAL CAMPAIGN ON EARTH" logo on a red background, along with copyright information: "©2020 Showtime Networks Inc., a ViacomCBS Company. SHOWTIME is accessible for viewing solely in the United States and its territories and possessions." and the "SHOWTIME" logo.
